subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait for and replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before starting its automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: The branch preserves a fallback only after recovery fails, but it still changes the primary user-visible disconnect policy, output timing, and delivery behavior established by the merged containment path.

options.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
options.body: Adopt recovery before fallback as the default and require current-head proof for successful recovery, recovery exhaustion, and the resulting user-facing diagnostics.

options.title: Retain immediate fallback
options.body: Keep the existing immediate isolated embedded fallback as the default and narrow or close this policy-changing recovery proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt recovery before fallback as the default and require current-head proof for successful recovery, recovery exhaustion, and the resulting user-facing diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged containment change authored by steipete defines the current fallback contract whose default behavior this PR changes.
